text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
An open-air café for a change of pace, is it……?
If you hadn't invited me, I doubt
I'd ever have visited such a place.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm usually quite busy, so I settle for meals
at the academy cafeteria. The food isn't bad at all, either.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there are a lot of students here.
I wonder if this is trending?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Hmm... To think there are even options with nutrition calculated specifically for Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Super-Sized High-Stamina Hachi-Milk" and
"Umastagrammable Jelly Soda"...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
choice_data_list: You can get it for takeout too.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? I make sure their meals
have their calories carefully counted, but...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
Let us adjust the menu.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Plus, it'll serve as a great catalyst to boost team morale.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...However, we must be careful not to let this lead to complacency.

Sipping on our drinks,
the two of us had a lively chat about the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case, the greatest burden upon an Umamusume is not pressure from others, but rather――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I must be heading back soon.
I have a meeting scheduled for the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
First, for takeout... Hmm.
Two kinds of drinks suitable for Umamusumes, is it?
choice_data_list: Let's go with the 'Mega-Size Hachi Milk'!
I'll definitely go with the 'Umastagrammable Soda'!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Honey Milk... I see, honey and milk.
It really is perfect timing, right as we've finished our solo training menu.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The sheer impact of that extra-large portion... Heh,
Bitter Glasse in particular will probably love it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It seems whenever she sees something massive,
her instinct is to immediately challenge it to a contest.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
She'll probably try to chug this down in one gulp too,
most likely. ...I must keep a close eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
Thank you very much for inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...That made for a fine souvenir.

Seeing her trying to carry all the baggage on her own,
I stepped in to help, and we returned to the academy together.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It's pleasing to the eyes,
and it lifts one's spirits as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you can choose the jelly's color?
If it's for Little Cocon... maybe something on the darker side.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That girl seems to have rather particular tastes,
or should I say, a strong obsession with aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very familiar with such things,
so I only have a vague sense of the atmosphere, but...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer <username>...
Would you mind helping me choose?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
. As thanks,
allow me to treat your pupil as well.

The two of us took our time carefully choosing
the jelly colors, obsessing over the presentation.
